en: Colorized historical street scene showing Meissner Strasse in Lommatzsch. The cobblestone street is lined with 2‑3 story townhouses with dormer roofs and shop signs in German. People stand on the sidewalk and a horse‑drawn wagon moves along the street. The sky is softly tinted blue and pink, giving a hand‑colored postcard look. Publisher information and date appear printed at the bottom right.
